senses.gloss:
[लिह्-घञ्] 
__1 Licking, sipper; as in मधुनो लेहः [[Bk. 6. 82.]] 
__2 Tasting. 
__3 A lambative, an electuary. 
__4 Food. 
__5 One of the ten ways in which an eclipse occurs; [[Bṛ. S.]] 
-ही A disease of the tips of the ears.

a. To be licked, to be eaten by licking, to be lapped up. 
-ह्यम् 
__1 Anything to be eaten by licking (as an article of food), a lambative; nectar. 
__2 Food in general.
